about.intro: Hi, I'm Ankit Dey, a full stack developer who enjoys building reliable APIs and clean, usable interfaces.
about.body: I specialize in Node.js, TypeScript, React.js, and relational databases like PostgreSQL and MySQL. During my internship at Flip Health, I worked on production REST APIs and React components used across a health-tech product.
about.closing: I enjoy solving backend problems, writing type-safe code, and continuously sharpening my data structures and algorithms skills.
about.role: Software Developer Intern @ Flip Health India

responsibilities: Developed and maintained REST APIs using Node.js and TypeScript, supporting core backend functionality across health-tech product modules.
Built interactive frontend components using React.js, improving UI consistency and reducing user-reported interface bugs.
Collaborated within an Agile team using Git/GitHub for version control and code reviews, delivering bi-weekly releases.
Containerized application services using Docker, cutting environment setup time and ensuring consistent deployments.
Used Postman to test and validate API endpoints, catching critical bugs pre-release and reducing production defects.

projects.name: Online Examination System
projects.description: A full-stack web-based examination platform serving 200+ students, with role-based access control and a real-time exam workflow.
highlights: Architected a full-stack exam platform serving 200+ students using TypeScript and React.js.
Designed RESTful APIs with PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM for exam scheduling, user records, and results.
Implemented Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for Admin and Student roles, eliminating unauthorized data access.
Built a responsive UI with real-time exam states, a countdown timer, and auto-submission.

projects.name: Movie Booking App
projects.description: A CRUD-based movie ticket booking system supporting concurrent bookings with zero data conflicts.
highlights: Developed a CRUD-based booking system (browse, book, update, cancel) supporting concurrent users.
Integrated MySQL with relational tables; TypeScript ensured type-safe interactions and fewer runtime errors.
Built a React.js frontend with interactive screens including a seat selection UI.
